title: The Dollhouse
hook: The twins' dollhouse was a perfect copy of their real house. Their mom had one rule for the babysitter: never move the dolls.
lines: The Marlowe twins had a dollhouse built just like their real house... down to the tiniest chair.
Their mom gave me one rule the night I started babysitting.
Never move the dolls. Whatever they're doing... leave them be.
There were four. A mother, a father... and two little girls in their beds.
My second week, a fifth doll showed up. A girl with a brown ponytail... just like mine.
Every night, she was somewhere new. The kitchen. The hallway. A little closer to the twins' room.
Then one Friday, near midnight, I heard a tiny click from the playroom.
The ponytail doll stood at the top of the dollhouse stairs... facing the twins' door.
I broke the rule. I pulled her out, and shoved her in my pocket.
Then, upstairs... the real stairs creaked. One step at a time.
When Mrs. Marlowe got home, she saw the empty dollhouse stairs... and went white.
That doll was you, she whispered. She keeps something off those stairs.
So what did you just let climb them?
